regions.merged_text: God bless you Joseph J. - with Win and all. I just read your interesting letter of July 5th and we surely appriciate your zeal and generosity. Many thanks and God's reward. We pray and trust that the new care-taker's hopeful report may turn out to have been not too optimistic. My new Rev. Associale, Fr. Simeon called my attention to special reference to enrollment of my Intent's. I just asked that he put it down in your own words. "I have plenty of them - and the O' Donnells always included. Thans be to God: I am feeling well again after just two weeks in the Hospital. Thanks be to God too for the ideal weather He has been sending us lately - not over hot during the day and cool rights. Many thanks and God's blessing to each and all. - Fr. Solanus, ofmc
